'''A5''' was an [[A5-series Assassin Droid]] operational during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After being sufficiently reprogrammed, A5 served as the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] at the [[Farrimmer Cafe]].
